Looking at this complex collection tracking problem, I'll work through each step systematically.

## Initial Setup
Starting with 33 items with specific attributes. Let me track the items by assigning them to their initial colors:
- Items 1: beige, 2: black, 3: blue, 4: gold, 5-6: gray, 7: green, 8-11: indigo, 12-13: khaki, 14-15: magenta, 16-18: orange, 19: red, 20: silver, 21-22: teal, 23-24: turquoise, 25-28: violet, 29-31: white, 32-33: yellow

## Step 1: Teacher Removes Items
Removes items with colors starting with "b" (beige, black, blue) OR names with 6 characters:
- Removed: items 1, 2, 3 (colors b, b, b), 8 (canvas-6 chars), 12 (wallet-6 chars), 15 (banana-6 chars), 17 (banana-6 chars), 18 (banana-6 chars), 22 (pencil-6 chars)
- Remaining: 24 items

## Step 2: Dad Removes All Items of One Color
After Step 1, teal items (item 21) is the only color that gets completely removed (went from 1 to 0).
- Remaining: 23 items

## Step 3: Friend Removes Items
Removes items with smell of leather, baking bread, or burning wood:
- Removes item 23 (Medium British apple with leather smell)
- Remaining: 22 items

## Step 4: Brother Replaces Extra-Large Items
Identifies extra-large items (items 9, 10, 32) and replaces each with:
- One copy with size changed to small
- One copy with color changed to green

This adds 3 + 3 = 6 items, for a total of 25 items.

## Step 5: Fiancée Adds Items with New (smell, color) Pairs
Items created by brother have new pairs not in initial collection:
- (popcorn, green) from items 9, 32
- (freshly cut grass, green) from item 10
- (freshly cut grass, khaki) from item 13 (existed before brother step)

Adds 4 items: 29 total

## Step 6: Lost One Extra-Extra-Large Item
Loses 1 item: 28 items remain

- Size is NOT extra-extra-large
